# MPS-C7 preventive maintenance

Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

This SOP covers fictional MPS-C7 clean tools C-01 and C-02.

## Bath

On the SC1 step, hold bath temperature inside {{window:C-01:SC1-SC2:sc1:bathTemperature}} and megasonic power inside {{window:C-01:SC1-SC2:sc1:megasonicPower}}. A particle excursion during a bath change is logged as an NCR and is separate from an etch or deposition investigation.

## Quartz

Bath quartz from Bramble Quartz Components is a clean-tool spare. It is not an etch edge ring.
